reason: Only MSAL's auth-code flow (acquireTokenByCode) is affected, fixed in 7.1.0. It reaches us as applicationinsights -> @azure/identity, and every @azure/identity release (4.14.0, beta 4.15.0-beta.1) still requires msal-node ^6. The API and the web app send telemetry with a connection string and run no MSAL flow. Remove when @azure/identity accepts msal-node >= 7.1.0.
